skillUsage.action: After receiving concurrent-write notice, re-read the shared Skill as one byte snapshot and capture real UTC read bounds and SHA-256; no shared files modified.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse, unquote
import re
import sys
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
readme = root / 'README.md'
links = re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', readme.read_text())
if not links:
    print('FAIL: README.md contains no navigable Markdown links')
    sys.exit(1)
failures = 0
for link in links:
    url = urlparse(link)
    if url.scheme or url.netloc:
        print('FAIL: external links are outside the authorized local validation scope:', link)
        failures += 1
        continue
    target = (readme.parent / unquote(url.path)).resolve()
    if root not in target.parents:
        print('FAIL: link escapes project root:', link)
        failures += 1
    elif not target.is_file():
        print('FAIL: missing local file:', link)
        failures += 1
    elif not target.read_text().strip():
        print('FAIL: empty target:', link)
        failures += 1
    elif 'current approved design description' not in target.read_text():
        print('FAIL: target does not identify itself as the current approved design:', link)
        failures += 1
    else:
        print('PASS: readable current design:', link)
print('Checked', len(links), 'README link(s); failures:', failures)
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
commands.coverage: Every README Markdown link must resolve inside the project to a nonempty readable current-design document.
